assertions: Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity.

TaskQXFX41 ports original ScInputMode NONE0 TYPE1 TABLE2 TOP3 and bounded ScInputHandler mode predicates/toggle at native source boundaries. Browser scalar input shares one draft:TYPE arrows commit/move,TABLE and TOP keep caret navigation. Original SID_SETINPUTMODE26552 and F2 use the same shared-menu dispatcher;TYPE/TABLE toggles preserve draft/history,TOP commits before TABLE and rejected input retains mode/error. GetMode is a read-only browser projection of eMode,not an upstream method. EditEngine,protection,formula reference selection,autocomplete and VCL synchronization remain unported;no full native input parity is claimed.

stackDivergence.rationale: React DOM composition shares Writer presentation and Sfx contracts while preserving actual Calc model/view/history ownership.

record.capability: Editable production Calc workspace over canonical scalar model
gaps: Full native menus,formatting/sidebar/status services,clipboard,rich/multiline cells,functions/ranges/cross-sheet references and locale-aware number formats remain outside this current-core slice.
Shared file dialogs,ODS filters,primary browser storage/autosave and close workflows are subsequent approved UI tasks;no recovery UI is introduced.
Token array copies share native const token identities;physical memory uses JS GC. Full native deep-copy/undo-document services and sheet reference transformation are not claimed.
Browser geometry is platform-owned;native row coordinates are projected onto a bounded physical scroll track. Exact VCL implementation parity is not claimed.
